title: Complexity concentration as a god-class and god-method detector: a pre-registered test of a scale-free outlier rule against tool definitions and human labels
title_zh: 作为上帝类与上帝方法检测器的复杂度集中度：无标度离群规则对抗工具定义与人工标签的预注册检验

paragraphs.en: God-class and god-method detectors mark concentrated complexity with a raw-scale threshold, a constant fitted on a corpus and re-fitted when the population moves. This paper pre-registers a test of a rule with no raw-scale constant: a unit is a god unit when its complexity is a robust outlier for its own codebase, a modified z-score of 3.5 or more. On 445 repositories in ten languages, 171 of them Java, and the 492 Java repositories of MLCQ, the rule is scored against PMD’s GodClass, MLCQ’s reviewers and two further definitions, with signal and cutoff chosen on half the repositories and read on the rest. LLM-written code may gather its complexity differently, the case for a detector that needs no re-fitting; the first question is whether one can match the scale of existing human-written code. The verdict is inconclusive on both populations, by different arms. The rule ranks PMD’s god classes from the per-file maximum of cognitive complexity at per-repository AUCs of 0.916 and 0.908. On the main run it is, at its default, non-inferior within the margin to a cutoff tuned on the same population on recovery, and flags about twice as many non-god classes; on MLCQ it flags about as many and falls short of the margin on pooled recovery. Pooled, the raw value ranks god classes better than the per-repository score, and a cutoff carried between the populations lost almost nothing: both are human-written code on one scale, so the test is of matching that scale, not of surviving a shift. The rule’s extra flags are small classes, just over half holding a method at PMD’s own method-level threshold; its misses are large classes whose complexity is spread over many methods. Two readers of the source did not agree on what the extra flags are. Concentration finds where the complexity is; whether that place is a god unit is a question about coupling, which a registered follow-on study takes up.

paragraphs.en: A god class is a class that does too much. Riel named the heuristic [ 27 ] , Fowler catalogued the smell as Large Class and its method-level twin as Long Method [ 13 ] , and Lanza and Marinescu turned the judgement into a detection strategy, a conjunction of metric thresholds [ 17 , 21 ] . Every threshold-based detector in use follows that template, and the thresholds are constants on a raw scale: a weighted method count of 47, a cyclomatic complexity of 14, a cognitive complexity of 15, fifty lines. The constants are frozen percentiles of a corpus [ 17 , 1 , 12 , 26 ] , and a constant derived from a corpus is a statement about that corpus. It has to be re-derived when the population moves, and there is evidence that it may be moving: projects that adopted an LLM coding agent showed a persistent rise in complexity [ 14 ] , and on a fixed assignment LLM-generated projects gathered their complexity into fewer classes, which the threshold-based detectors missed [ 31 ] . A detector whose constant is fitted to the codebase in front of it would then be worth having, but agent-written code is not yet available at the scale a pre-registered test needs, so the first step, and this paper’s question, is whether such a detector can match the single scale of existing human-written code at all.
paragraphs.zh: 上帝类是指承担了过多职责的类。 Riel 提出了这一启发式规则 [ 27 ]，Fowler 将该坏味道归类为过大类，并将其方法层面的孪生问题归类为过长方法 [ 13]，而 Lanza 和 Marinescu 则把这种判断转化为一种检测策略，即多个度量阈值的合取 [ 17 , 21 ]。 目前在用的每一个基于阈值的检测器都遵循这一模板，而这些阈值是原始尺度上的常数：加权方法数为 47、圈复杂度为 14、认知复杂度为 15、五十行代码。 这些常数是某个语料库的冻结百分位数 [ 17 , 1 , 12 , 26 ]，而由语料库导出的常数只是针对该语料库的一种论断。 当总体发生变化时，这些常数必须重新推导，而且有证据表明总体可能正在变化：采用大语言模型编码智能体的项目复杂度持续上升 [ 14 ]，并且在同一作业任务下，由大语言模型生成的项目把复杂度集中到了更少的类中，从而被基于阈值的检测器漏检 [ 31 ]。 因此，一个常数能针对其面前代码库进行拟合的检测器是有价值的，但智能体编写的代码尚未达到预注册检验所需的规模，所以第一步，也就是本文要提出的问题是：这样的检测器究竟是否能够匹配现有人类编写代码的单一尺度。

paragraphs.en: The alternative is a rule whose constant lives on a standardised axis. Standardise every unit by its own repository’s median and median absolute deviation and flag the units whose modified z-score is 3.5 or more, Iglewicz and Hoaglin’s rule [ 16 ] . The 3.5 is still a constant, but the scale it is applied to, the median and the MAD, is fitted on the codebase at the time of use and carries no corpus: the rule is scale-free, not constant-free. The question arose in a companion study [ 28 ] , which found the amount of complexity an AI agent produced on a fixed task steady across architectures and instructions while its placement moved by factors of three to ten. Placement, not amount, was what a design decided, and that turned attention from the level of a unit’s complexity to its concentration . The claim this paper tests is that a scale-free relative outlier in a per-unit complexity measure that is not size recovers the classes and methods that tuned, absolute-threshold definitions mark, and that human reviewers mark, without a raw-scale constant.
paragraphs.zh: 另一种选择是一条其常量位于标准化轴上的规则。 用每个单元自身仓库的中位数和中位数绝对偏差对每个单元进行标准化，并标记修正 z 分数达到 3.5 或以上的单元，这是 Iglewicz 和 Hoaglin 的规则 [ 16 ] 。 3.5 仍然是一个常量，但它所应用的尺度——中位数和 MAD——是在使用时基于代码库拟合的，不携带任何语料库：这条规则是无尺度的，而非无常量的。 这个问题源于一项配套研究 [ 28 ] ，该研究发现，智能体在固定任务上产生的复杂度数量在不同架构和指令下保持稳定，而其位置却移动了三到十倍。 设计所决定的是位置，而非数量，这把注意力从单元复杂度的水平转移到了它的集中度上。 本文检验的论断是：在一个并非规模的按单元复杂度度量中，无尺度的相对离群值能够恢复经调优的绝对阈值定义所标记的类和方法，以及人类评审者所标记的类和方法，而无需原始尺度的常量。

paragraphs.en: The claim was pre-registered: the primary estimand, the decision rule and its margins, the families a signal may be chosen from, the sample seed and the bootstrap were committed and tagged before the confirmatory sample was drawn. The design is tilted against the claim: every tool oracle is itself an absolute threshold, and the competitor is a cutoff tuned on the explore half of the same population, which is the right competitor for the first step, since matching a tuned constant on its own population is the bar a scale-free rule must clear before a shifted population is worth testing. The paper has three findings.

paragraphs.en: The two populations sit on one raw scale, so the first step is well posed. paragraphs.en: The errors have a shape. The rule’s extra flags are small, mostly uncoupled classes, just over half holding a method at PMD’s own method-level threshold; its misses are large classes whose complexity is spread over many moderate methods. Against MLCQ’s reviewers no detector agrees with the Blob verdicts beyond an MCC of about 0.24, and on Long Method the relative rule has the highest point estimate of the detectors tried. Whether a concentration of complexity is a god unit is a coupling question, which a follow-on study, registered before these numbers existed, takes up.

paragraphs.en: Marinescu’s detection strategy is a conjunction of metric filters with thresholds [ 21 ] ; Lanza and Marinescu fixed the GodClass thresholds from forty-five systems [ 17 ] , DECOR expressed the Blob as a rule card over size, cohesion and association with data classes [ 23 ] , and PMD implements the Lanza–Marinescu GodClass directly. Every one of these has a coupling or cohesion clause beside the complexity clause; this paper uses them as oracles for the complexity clause. That the constants are hard to justify is an old observation: thresholds have been derived from benchmarks [ 1 ] , fitted distributions [ 12 ] , relative positions in a corpus [ 26 ] , per language [ 15 ] and per architectural role [ 3 ] . Each still ships a constant derived from systems other than the one scored, and Baxter et al. found the shape of the distributions those constants cut varying with the application [ 5 ] . The rule tested here is fitted on each repository’s own units at the time of use.
paragraphs.zh: Marinescu 的检测策略是带阈值的度量过滤器的合取 [ 21 ]；Lanza 和 Marinescu 基于四十五个系统确定了 GodClass 的阈值 [ 17]，DECOR 将 Blob 表示为一条关于规模、内聚以及与数据类关联的规则卡片 [ 23]，而 PMD 则直接实现了 Lanza–Marinescu 的 GodClass。 其中每一条在复杂性条款旁边都有一条耦合或内聚条款；本文将它们用作复杂性条款的判定基准。 常量难以给出合理依据是一个由来已久的观察：阈值曾被从基准数据 [ 1]、拟合分布 [ 12]、语料库中的相对位置 [ 26]、按语言 [ 15] 以及按架构角色 [ 3] 等方式推导出来。 每种方法仍然使用一个从其他系统而非被评分系统推导出的常量，而 Baxter 等人发现这些常量所切分的分布形状随应用程序而变化 [ 5]。 本文测试的规则是在使用时针对每个仓库自身的单元拟合而成的。

paragraphs.en: The confound that matters is size: El Emam et al. showed most object-oriented metrics confounded with class size [ 11 ] , and every per-file sum is nearly collinear with the size clause of every definition. The study therefore assigns every signal to a family in advance, size (per-file sums and the method count), peak (per-file maxima) and density (per-file means) at class level, and the primary may be chosen from the peak and density families only.
paragraphs.zh: 真正重要的混淆因素是规模：El Emam 等人表明，大多数面向对象度量与类规模存在混淆 [ 11 ]，而每个按文件求和的指标与每个定义中的规模子句几乎共线。 因此，本研究预先将每个信号归入一个族：类级别上的规模（按文件求和与方法数量）、峰值（按文件最大值）与密度（按文件均值），而主要度量只能从峰值族和密度族中选取。

paragraphs.en: MLCQ is a data set of code smell reviews by professional developers on Java open-source samples, graded without a given definition and with several reviewers per sample [ 18 ] ; classifiers trained on it reach a median MCC of about 0.51 for Blob and 0.81 for Long Method [ 19 ] , a reference point rather than a baseline, since the rule here never sees the labels. Learned detectors are the other route past a hand-set constant: Arcelli Fontana et al. benchmarked sixteen learners on hand-labelled smells [ 4 ] , and Di Nucci et al. showed the figures fell once the benchmark’s balance and overlap were corrected [ 10 ] . A learned detector carries its corpus in its weights as a fitted threshold carries it in a constant; neither is tested here. Schumacher et al. found developers agree with one another only moderately on god classes [ 29 ] . The reviewers graded samples without the repository in view, so a human label is an absolute judgement by a reader’s own budget: external, not scale-free, and the one oracle with no numeric constant inside it.
paragraphs.zh: MLCQ 是一个由专业开发者对 Java 开源样本进行代码坏味评审的数据集，评分时未提供定义，且每个样本有多位评审者 [ 18 ] ；在其上训练的分类器对 Blob 达到约 0.51 的中位 MCC，对 Long Method 达到 0.81 [ 19 ] ，这是一个参照点而非基线，因为此处的规则从不接触这些标签。 学习型检测器是绕过手工设定常数的另一条路径：Arcelli Fontana 等人在人工标注的坏味上对十六种学习器进行了基准测试 [ 4 ] ，而 Di Nucci 等人表明，在修正了基准的类别平衡与重叠问题后，这些数字有所下降 [ 10 ] 。 学习型检测器把语料库保存在其权重中，正如拟合出的阈值把它保存在一个常数中；两者都不在本文的测试范围内。 Schumacher 等人发现，开发者之间对上帝类（god classes）的判断仅达到中等程度的一致 [ 29 ] 。 评审者在看不到代码仓库的情况下为样本评分，因此人工标签是读者依据自身预算做出的绝对判断：它是外部的，而非无尺度的，并且是唯一一个内部不含数值常数的裁决依据。

paragraphs.en: The primary rule is the modified z-score,
paragraphs.zh: 基本规则是修正 z 分数（modified z-score），

paragraphs.en: with x ~ \tilde{x} the median and MAD the median absolute deviation of every unit in the repository at that level, zeros included. When more than half the units tie at the median the MAD is zero and the rule falls back to the mean absolute deviation with its normal consistency constant; which scale was used is recorded, because the rule is scale-free but not shape-free. paragraphs.en: A within-repository AUC is invariant to any monotone per-repository transform, so it is identical under the relative and the absolute view: it is evidence about the signal, never about scale-freeness. The threshold-free reading pools every repository’s units into one ranking, once on the raw value and once on the per-repository modified z, and compares the two pooled AUCs as a paired difference. The operating-point reading compares the relative rule at its literature default with the single raw-scale cutoff that maximised the pooled MCC on the explore half, both on the confirm half. Every tool definition is itself an absolute threshold, so this comparison is tilted toward the absolute competitor: a relative win is strong evidence, a relative loss weak evidence against relative rules in general. A relative rule also cannot see what an absolute rule uses: in a repository of uniformly small classes it must still flag something and PMD marks nothing. Those false positives are reported, and the decision has an arm that sees them.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库内 AUC 对任何按仓库的单调变换都保持不变，因此在相对视角和绝对视角下完全相同：它证明的是信号本身的存在，而与是否具有尺度无关性无关。 无阈值的读法将所有仓库的单元合并成一个排序，一次基于原始值，一次基于按仓库计算的修正 z 值，并将两个合并后的 AUC 作为配对差值进行比较。 操作点的读法将相对规则在其文献默认设置下的表现，与在探索半部分上使合并 MCC 最大化的单一原始尺度截断值进行比较，两者均在确认半部分上评估。 每个工具定义本身就是一个绝对阈值，因此这种比较偏向于绝对的竞争者：相对规则获胜是有力的证据，而相对规则落败则只是反对相对规则整体的弱证据。 相对规则也无法看到绝对规则所使用的信息：在一个类普遍很小的仓库中，它仍然必须标记出某些东西，而 PMD 却什么也不标记。 这些误报会被报告出来，并且该决策中有一个分支能够看到它们。

sents.en: Every tool definition is itself an absolute threshold, so this comparison is tilted toward the absolute competitor: a relative win is strong evidence, a relative loss weak evidence against relative rules in general.
sents.zh: 每个工具定义本身就是一个绝对阈值，因此这种比较偏向于绝对的竞争者：相对规则获胜是有力的证据，而相对规则落败则只是反对相对规则整体的弱证据。

sents.en: A relative rule also cannot see what an absolute rule uses: in a repository of uniformly small classes it must still flag something and PMD marks nothing.
sents.zh: 相对规则也无法看到绝对规则所使用的信息：在一个类普遍很小的仓库中，它仍然必须标记出某些东西，而 PMD 却什么也不标记。

sents.en: Those false positives are reported, and the decision has an arm that sees them.
sents.zh: 这些误报会被报告出来，并且该决策中有一个分支能够看到它们。

paragraphs.en: Pre-registered, and read as the weakest of three paired comparisons of the relative rule at its default minus the tuned absolute cutoff, each on the same confirm repositories with a 95% percentile bootstrap of 2,000 resamples over repositories: macro MCC , the mean per-repository MCC difference over the confirm repositories with at least one positive; micro MCC , the pooled MCC difference over every confirm repository carrying the definition, god-free ones included; and macro FPR , the mean per-repository false-positive-rate difference over every confirm repository, lower being better. On the MCC arms the relative rule is superior if the lower bound of the difference is above 0, non-inferior if above − m -m , inferior if the upper bound is below − m -m , and inconclusive otherwise, with m = min ( 0.10 , 0.30 × m=\min(0.10,\ 0.30\times the explore-half macro MCC of the relative rule ) ) . On the FPR arm the rule is non-inferior if the upper bound is below + 0.05 +0.05 , superior if below 0, inferior if the lower bound is above + 0.05 +0.05 . A signal carries the definition only if the lower bound of the confirm macro AUC is at least 0.70, and the primary is confirmatory only on at least 20 confirm repositories with three or more positives and 40 carrying the definition. The power analysis behind these constants, from a seed-1 pilot of 522 repositories, is in the registered plan: a margin of 0.05 was not resolvable at any affordable sample, 0.10 from about sixty confirm repositories. A margin of 0.10 is about a third of the MCC levels realised here, so non-inferiority on an MCC arm is a weak bar, and the point estimates are read beside the verdict for that reason.
paragraphs.zh: 预注册分析将相对规则在默认设置下与调优后的绝对截止阈值进行三组成对比较中最弱的一组解读为：在同一批确认仓库上，采用对仓库进行的 95% 百分位自助法（2,000 次重抽样）：宏观 MCC，即在每个至少有一个正例的确认仓库上 MCC 差值的平均值；微观 MCC，即在所有携带该定义的确认仓库（包括无神谕的仓库）上的汇总 MCC 差值；以及宏观 FPR，即在所有确认仓库上每个仓库假阳性率差值的平均值，越低越好。 在 MCC 组上，若差值的下界高于 0，则相对规则为优效；若高于 − m -m，则为非劣效；若上界低于 − m -m，则为劣效；否则为不确定，其中 m = min ( 0.10 , 0.30 × m=\min(0.10,\ 0.30\times 相对规则在探索半区的宏观 MCC ) ) 。 在 FPR 组上，若上界低于 + 0.05 +0.05，则该规则为非劣效；若低于 0，则为优效；若下界高于 + 0.05 +0.05，则为劣效。 只有当确认集宏观 AUC 的下界不低于 0.70 时，信号才被认为携带该定义；而主判定只有在至少 20 个具有三个或更多正例的确认仓库、以及至少 40 个携带该定义的确认仓库上，才具有确证性。 这些常数背后的功效分析（来自 522 个仓库的 seed-1 试点）载于注册方案：0.05 的边际在任何可承受的样本量下都无法分辨，而 0.10 的边际大约需要六十个确认仓库。 0.10 的边际约为本文实现的 MCC 水平的三分之一，因此在 MCC 组上的非劣效是一个较弱的标准，正是出于这个原因，点估计值与判定结果一并解读。

paragraphs.en: Repositories are drawn by a seeded, stratified sampler, a separate tool of the author’s whose only inputs are GitHub’s search index and criteria fixed before any repository is inspected: ten languages (Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, C, C++, C#, PHP and Rust) by three popularity tiers (above 5,000 stars, 1,000 to 5,000, 200 to 999), 170,596 repositories in the frame, shuffled under the pre-registered seed 2. A candidate is usable on size alone, at least 50 functions in at least 15 source files, decided before any detection outcome. The author’s own ecosystem is excluded. The draw overlaps the seed-1 pilot in 1 repository, runkids/skillshare, which is Go, so the plan’s re-read of the primary without the pilot’s repositories is the primary itself. Each language is drawn to 30 usable repositories and, because every composite class-level definition is Java-only, a Java supplement is drawn with the same seed to a target of 150, of which 141 were usable; with the 30 Java repositories of the main draw that gives 171 Java repositories among 445. A repository is stratified by the language GitHub indexes it under and counted by the language found dominant on measurement; 30 repositories of the main draw differ on the two, so the counts by measured language sit near 30 rather than at it. Each repository is pinned to the commit its default branch was on when drawn. Because every composite definition is Java-only, the other nine languages enter only the internal Brain Method comparison and the shape diagnostics of Section 5.1 ; every headline number is a Java number. The 445 rows have 430 distinct GitHub owners, so the bootstrap’s assumption of independent repositories is close to met in the main run; it is not met in the MLCQ run, where apache alone holds 50.2% of the repositories, and MLCQ’s intervals are read with that in mind.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库由一个带种子、分层的抽样器抽取，这是作者的另一个工具，其唯一输入是 GitHub 的搜索索引和在任何仓库被检查前就固定的标准：十种语言（Java、Python、JavaScript、TypeScript、Go、C、C++、C#、PHP 和 Rust）乘以三个流行度层级（5000 星以上、1000 到 5000、200 到 999），总体中共有 170,596 个仓库，并按预先注册的种子 2 进行了随机打乱。 一个候选仓库仅凭规模即可判定为可用：至少在 15 个源文件中有至少 50 个函数，这一标准在任何检测结果出来之前就已确定。 作者自己的生态系统被排除在外。 这次抽取与种子 1 的试运行有 1 个仓库重叠，即 runkids/skillshare，它是 Go 项目，因此按计划在不包含试运行仓库的情况下对主抽取的重新读取就是主抽取本身。 每种语言抽取到 30 个可用仓库，并且由于每个复合的类级定义都仅限 Java，用相同的种子额外抽取了一个目标为 150 个的 Java 补充集，其中 141 个可用；加上主抽取中的 30 个 Java 仓库，在 445 个仓库中共有 171 个 Java 仓库。 仓库按 GitHub 索引时采用的语言进行分层，并按测量中发现占主导地位的语言进行计数；主抽取中有 30 个仓库在这两者上不一致，因此按测量语言计的数目接近 30 而非恰好为 30。 每个仓库被固定在抽取时其默认分支所在的提交上。 由于每个复合定义都仅限 Java，其余九种语言只参与内部的 Brain Method 比较和 5.1 节的形态诊断；所有主要数字都是 Java 的数字。 这 445 行数据来自 430 个不同的 GitHub 所有者，因此自举法对仓库相互独立的假设在主运行中接近满足；但在 MLCQ 运行中该假设不成立，仅 apache 一个所有者就占有 50.2% 的仓库，阅读 MLCQ 的区间时需牢记这一点。

paragraphs.en: Every function of every source file outside test, vendored and build directories is measured with lizard [ 30 ] for cyclomatic complexity [ 22 ] , lines and tokens, and by the harness’s own scanners for cognitive complexity [ 6 ] , nesting, Halstead volume, maintainability burden, exit points and parameters. Class level is the file, with each measure aggregated over the file’s functions as a sum, a mean and a maximum, plus the method count; the cyclomatic sum is WMC [ 8 ] . A file is positive under a class definition when any class it holds meets it; 23% of Java files hold more than one class. The lexical estimators track PMD’s own values on every Java method at Spearman 0.95 for cyclomatic and 0.97 for cognitive, with AUCs against PMD’s own thresholds of 0.997 and above, so a weak result cannot be blamed on the estimators.
paragraphs.zh: 对于测试、第三方代码和构建目录之外的每个源文件的每个函数，使用 lizard [ 30 ] 度量圈复杂度 [ 22 ]、行数和词元数，并由评测框架自带的扫描器度量认知复杂度 [ 6 ]、嵌套深度、Halstead 体量、可维护性负担、出口数量和参数数量。 类级别即文件级别，每一项度量指标在文件的各函数上按总和、均值和最大值进行聚合，并外加方法计数；圈复杂度之和即为 WMC [ 8 ] 。 在类定义下，只要文件所包含的任何一个类满足该定义，该文件即为正例；23% 的 Java 文件包含不止一个类。 这些词法估计器在所有 Java 方法上追踪 PMD 自身的值，圈复杂度的 Spearman 相关系数为 0.95，认知复杂度为 0.97，针对 PMD 自身阈值的 AUC 达到 0.997 及以上，因此较弱的结果不能归咎于这些估计器。

paragraphs.en: The headline definitions are PMD’s GodClass (tool, Java, class level), PMD’s NPath rule at 200 [ 24 ] (tool, Java, method level), an approximate DECOR Blob composed from CK’s counts [ 2 ] as its LargeClass and LowCohesion clauses alone, the ControllerClass and association clauses omitted (composed, Java), the study’s own Brain Method (fifty lines, cyclomatic 14 and nesting 5; internal, every language, read as internal consistency only), and the human labels of MLCQ. PMD and CK run without an auxiliary classpath; the size of that under-count is bounded in Section 6 . Every rule is fitted on exactly the population it scores, the whole per-level universe of the repository with zeros included. A definition scoped to Java is scored on Java units only.

paragraphs.en: Every usable repository is assigned to an explore or a confirm half from the sample file alone, stratified by language and tier, and the assignment is recorded in every row before the first repository is measured. paragraphs.en: At class level the chosen signal’s modified z used the MAD scale in 89% of repositories. At method level the zero-heavy signals fall back to the mean absolute deviation far more often: cyclomatic complexity, which is 1 for more than half of all methods, used the MAD scale in only 34% of repositories. The method-level rule is therefore fitted on populations that tie at the floor, and its flag rate is a property of the tail’s shape as much as of its constant. At class level the default flags between 8.4% and 12.3% of files in the median repository of each language: no language sits apart, but a rule that admits a tenth of the population is not an outlier rule in the usual sense, and the heavy tail against a small MAD that collapses the method-level rule is present at class level too, in milder form.
paragraphs.zh: 在类级别，所选信号的修正 z 值在 89% 的仓库中使用 MAD 尺度。 在方法级别，零值密集的信号回退到平均绝对偏差的情况要频繁得多：圈复杂度在超过一半的方法中取值为 1，仅在 34% 的仓库中使用 MAD 尺度。 因此，方法级别的规则是在大量堆积在下限的总体上拟合的，其标记率既取决于其常数，也同样取决于尾部的形状。 在类级别，默认设置在每种语言的中位数仓库中标记 8.4% 到 12.3% 的文件：没有哪种语言显得特殊，但一条容纳十分之一总体的规则并不是通常意义上的离群值规则，而且那种在小 MAD 背景下拖着重尾、从而使方法级别规则失效的现象，在类级别同样存在，只是形式较为温和。

paragraphs.en: At the operating point (Table 1 ) the two rules reach almost the same macro MCC and the relative rule a lower micro MCC. paragraphs.en: At method level the rule is inferior against PMD’s NPath: cyclomatic complexity ranks the positives at a macro AUC of 0.996, but with more than half of all methods at cyclomatic 1 the scale collapses to a mean deviation, 3.5 of it is a low bar, and the rule flags a twentieth of every repository’s methods at precision 0.07 (micro MCC difference − - 0.331 [ − - 0.380, − - 0.284]). Tuned on the main run the cutoff is cognitive_max ≥ 22 \geq 22 , on MLCQ ≥ 17 \geq 17 ; read on the main run, MLCQ’s cutoff does slightly better than the main run’s own (paired micro MCC difference +0.015 [ − - 0.003, +0.034]), and read on MLCQ the main run’s costs − - 0.007 [ − - 0.020, +0.006]. paragraphs.en: Read with care, the transfer says less than it seems to. A pooled objective that cannot tell 22 from 17 cannot tell whether the scale moved by that much either, so the transfer is weak evidence for a shared scale and no evidence of a shift; it also means the competitor in the primary was loosely identified, which if anything understates the rule’s deficit. The sharper test is the threshold-free one of Section 5.2 : pooling every confirm unit, the per-repository modified z ranks god classes worse than the raw value on both populations, − - 0.020 [ − - 0.033, − - 0.008] and − - 0.045 [ − - 0.080, − - 0.024], both resolved. One raw axis serves every repository in both populations better than each repository’s own. The comparisons above are therefore a test of matching a single human scale, not of drift: a constant against an oracle built from the same constant cannot show the oracle’s constant moving, and neither population is agent-written.

paragraphs.en: The extra flags are not god classes by size: only 24.1% of them pass the size clause against 96.8% of the classes PMD marks, a coupling component marks 38.5% against 74.3%, and the cohesion components separate nothing. What does mark them is PMD’s method-level rule: 56.3% hold a method at or above cognitive complexity 15, against 2.4% of unflagged classes. The absolute cutoff’s own extra flags are larger and more often coupled: at a raw cutoff the extra flags are big classes that missed on data access or cohesion, at a relative cut they are small classes with one complex method, in the median a file of about ten methods and, in just over half of cases, a method at PMD’s cognitive threshold in a small class.

paragraphs.en: Table 6 gives the reading. The two readers do not agree on what the files are: to the author 75% of the extra flags are gatherers, to the model 66% are leaves, and on the 40 units both read they agree on 21, Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.20. Each reads the two groups more alike than apart. The disagreement sits in the responsibility question ( κ \kappa 0.07), which the model answers yes for 96% of the extra flags and 82% of PMD’s god classes and the author for 30% and 5%. The one question they answer alike is whether the class works mostly on other objects’ data ( κ \kappa 0.61, against 0.23 on the algorithm question and 0.22 on the dispatch table): yes for 40% of the extra flags against 70% of PMD’s god classes to the author and 16% against 22% to the model, the same direction for both, but neither difference resolved, Fisher’s exact test giving p = 0.111 p=0.111{} and p = 0.368 p=0.368{} . The differences that do resolve are the model’s, on responsibility ( p = 0.003 p=0.003{} ) and so on gatherers ( p = 0.045 p=0.045{} ), on the question the readers answer least alike; those are two of sixteen uncorrected tests, eight per reader, and are read as exploratory. The reading establishes neither that the extra flags are leaves nor that a reader can tell them from PMD’s god classes by eye; what two readers could judge alike is the coupling question the follow-on study measures rather than reads.

paragraphs.en: PMD and CK ran without an auxiliary classpath, so GodClass’s data-access clause sees only the sources. The plan bounded that under-count by building at least ten explore-half Java repositories with their own build tool and re-running PMD with the built classpath, with a bound of 10%; it was due before the confirm half was read and was run after, on explore repositories only. Of 29 candidates worked down in seeded order, 10 built. 26 of 390 verdicts flipped, 6.7%, every one a god class gained with the classpath; 23 of them are in one repository (Anuken/Mindustry, 16.3%) and over the other nine the rate is 1.2%. The bound is met. The under-count is one-sided, every flip a god class gained, but its effect on the paired comparison is not: a gained god class the rule had flagged turns a false positive into a hit, and one it had not flagged adds a miss. At 6.7% of verdicts, 1.2% outside one repository, the effect is small in either direction. Because the order was wrong the confirmatory analysis file records the primary as not confirmatory for want of the validation, and the re-analysis that applied the bound is a dated exploratory file; the two agree on every number. A reader who holds to the plan’s order may read the primary as exploratory.

paragraphs.en: Against PMD’s GodClass the scale-free rule did not beat the tuned cutoff on any arm, and every point estimate of the primary is on the cutoff’s side; its one resolved win against a tool definition, fewer false positives against the approximate DECOR Blob, is on a secondary. Every tool oracle is a raw-scale constant, so against the tools these comparisons could at best have shown the rule matching a constant, and a loss against them is weak evidence, as Section 3 said in advance. The one oracle with no constant inside it, the reviewers, is read on too few repositories to decide. The confirmatory verdict therefore answers a narrower question than the title asks: whether a relative outlier recovers PMD’s verdicts as well as a constant tuned to them. On one population it does, within the margin, and on the other it falls short on pooled recovery; whether it recovers a constant-free judgement of a god unit as well as a constant does is left open.

paragraphs.en: The case for a scale-free detector is that agent-written code may concentrate complexity differently from the corpora the constants were fitted on [ 14 , 31 ] ; in a lab setting, agents building whole applications have been seen to centralise logic into single “manager” classes [ 32 ] , while on files with explicit LLM attribution in real repositories class-level metrics sit at near parity with human-written code [ 20 ] , so the shift, if there is one, may be small. That case cannot be tested until populations of agent-written code exist at scale, and a detector that fails on human-written code would have nothing to offer them. This study is the first step, on human-written code. The second is the follow-on coupling study, which asks whether the false positives can be separated from the god units by what a unit does with other objects’ data. The third, which neither study makes, is to take the refined detector to agent-written code, by agent adoption as He et al. did for complexity [ 14 ] or under a fixed task as Zhang, Wen and Tempero did [ 31 ] . Nothing here measures whether the scale moves.

paragraphs.en: At method level most methods have the lowest possible value, the robust scale collapses to a mean deviation, and 3.5 of it is a low bar; yet on the structure signals the default rule reaches a micro MCC within 0.08 of a tuned cutoff against the reviewers’ Long Method verdicts. The constant is the problem, not the standardisation. The same diagnosis applies, in milder form, at class level, where the default admits a tenth of files. A scale-free rule needs a constant fitted to the shape of these distributions; the natural candidate is the same rule on a logarithmic axis, a modified z of log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) , which is as scale-free as the rule tested and compresses the tail that collapses the MAD. It was not run and belongs in a registered follow-on.
paragraphs.zh: 在方法层面，大多数方法的取值都是可能的最低值，稳健尺度退化为一平均偏差，其 3.5 倍是一个很低的门槛；然而在结构信号上，面对评审人员对 Long Method（过长方法）的判定，默认规则与调优后的阈值相比，微观 MCC 的差距在 0.08 以内。 问题出在常数上，而不是标准化。 同样的诊断也适用于类层面，只是程度较轻，默认规则在该层面会放行十分之一的文件。 一个不依赖尺度的规则需要一个根据这些分布形态拟合的常数；自然的候选方案是在对数轴上使用同一规则，即对 log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) 采用修正 z 分数，它与被测规则一样不依赖尺度，并且能压缩导致 MAD 失效的尾部。 该实验并未运行，应留作注册的后续研究。

paragraphs.en: The rule’s extra flags are small classes with one steep method, one in six of them a Blob to MLCQ’s reviewers, more than twice the rate among unflagged classes and less than among PMD’s flags; its misses are large, coupled classes whose complexity is nowhere steep; and reading the source separated neither group from PMD’s god classes to either reader. The reading that fits is that complexity concentration locates where a codebase’s complexity has gathered, and that whether the place is a god unit is legible neither in the complexity nor, reliably, in a reader’s sense of responsibility. A leaf that holds the complexity of the algorithm it computes, a parser, a solver, a state machine, is an outlier for its repository and is where that complexity belongs. Complexity alone cannot tell it from a class that gathers responsibilities; every definition in this study that does so adds a coupling clause to do it. The follow-on study asks whether a unit’s coupling divergence, what it hands on to the rest of the system against what it receives, separates a complex leaf from a god unit among the units complexity alone flags. Its plan was registered before the human-label numbers here existed and records what of this study it had seen.
paragraphs.zh: 该规则的额外标记是只有单个陡峭方法的小类，其中六分之一在 MLCQ 的评审者眼中是 Blob，是未标记类中该比例的两倍多，但低于 PMD 标记的类中的比例；它的漏标是大而高度耦合的类，其复杂度并不陡峭；而阅读源码并不能把这两组类与 PMD 的上帝类区分开，无论对哪位读者而言都是如此。 与之相符的解释是：复杂度聚集定位的是一个代码库中复杂度汇聚之处，而该处是否是一个上帝单元，既无法从复杂度本身看出，也无法可靠地从读者对职责的感知中看出。 一个承载了它所计算的算法之复杂度的叶子单元——比如一个解析器、一个求解器、一个状态机——对其所在的仓库来说是一个离群点，而这正是该复杂度理应所在之处。 仅凭复杂度无法把它与一个聚集了多种职责的类区分开；本研究中每一个能做到这一点的定义都加入了耦合条款来加以区分。 后续研究将追问：一个单元的耦合差异——即它向系统其余部分传递的东西相对于它接收的东西——能否在仅凭复杂度被标记的单元中，把一个复杂的叶子单元与一个上帝单元区分开。 该研究的计划在本研究中的人工标注数字产生之前就已注册，并记录了它曾接触过本研究的哪些内容。

paragraphs.en: GitHub repositories of 200 stars or more, ten languages, one commit each, with equal allocation across tiers, so pooled numbers are not population estimates. The sampler is the author’s own tool; its draw is reproducible from the published derivation, and the published sample files, pinned to commits, are the record.

paragraphs.en: One primary, one decision rule and one read of the confirm half were fixed in advance; everything added after review is labelled exploratory, and the one favourable human-label number is a best-of-many comparison a reader should expect to shrink. The reading has two readers, one the author and the other a language model whose answers are not a human’s, who agree on the category at a κ \kappa of 0.20; the author read 40 units, the reading was blind to PMD’s verdict and not to size, and a third reader would be needed to say which reading is the better one. The model is a commercial product whose behaviour can change between releases, so its archived sessions, not a re-run, are the record.
paragraphs.zh: 一个主要结果、一条决策规则和一半确证性阅读的事先固定；审阅后补充的所有内容均标注为探索性，而那个有利的人工标注数字是多中取优的比较，读者应预期它会缩水。 这项阅读有两名读者，一名是作者，另一名是语言模型，其回答并非人类的回答，两者在 κ \kappa 为 0.20 的水平上一致；作者阅读了 40 个单元，阅读过程对 PMD 的判定是盲的，但对规模不盲，若要判断哪种阅读更好，还需要第三名读者。 该模型是一款商业产品，其行为可能在不同版本间发生变化，因此记录是其归档的会话，而非重新运行的结果。

paragraphs.en: Every number in this paper is produced by a script from the harness’s output. The ancillary data holds the harness’s confirmatory analysis files and the dated exploratory re-analysis, the sample files and frozen explore/confirm assignments, the per-repository summaries and definition registries, the converted MLCQ labels, the classpath reports, the paper’s own reductions, and every reader’s answers on the false-positive sample with the model reader’s recorded sessions, with the digests as committed. The raw per-unit data regenerates by running the harness on the published sample files, and the ancillary README names the public repositories of the harness, the sampler, the companion study and the follow-on study, with the command behind every number.
paragraphs.zh: 本文中的每个数字都由一个脚本从该评测框架的输出中生成。 辅助数据保存了该评测框架的验证性分析文件和注明日期的探索性再分析、样本文件以及冻结的探索/验证任务分配、每个代码仓库的摘要和定义注册表、转换后的 MLCQ 标签、类路径报告、论文自身的归纳整理，以及每位读者在假阳性样本上的答案和模型阅读器记录的会话，均以提交的摘要为准。 原始的逐单元数据可通过在已发布的样本文件上运行该评测框架来重新生成，辅助 README 中列出了该评测框架、抽样器、配套研究和后续研究的公开代码仓库，以及每个数字背后的命令。

paragraphs.en: A unit whose complexity is a robust outlier for its own codebase ranks above the classes PMD does not call god classes in nine pairs of ten, on two populations of human-written code that sit on one raw scale, and at its literature default comes within the pre-registered margin of a cutoff tuned to that scale on one population and short of it on the other, at about twice the false positives on the first. The verdict is inconclusive, and the result that carries forward is the shape of the errors. Concentration finds where the complexity is. Some of those places are god units and some are small classes doing the work they were written to do, and a complexity measure cannot tell the two apart because the difference is not in the complexity. Two readers of the source could not tell them apart by eye either, and agreed with each other on one question only, whether the class works on other objects’ data. That is a coupling question, and it warrants the next study, which measures it; the detector that study refines is the one to take to agent-written code.
paragraphs.zh: 一个其复杂度在自己代码库中是稳健离群值的单元，在十组配对中有九组排在 PMD 不称之为上帝类的类之上——这两个群体是人类编写、位于同一原始尺度上的代码；在其文献默认阈值下，它在其中一个群体上落入针对该尺度调校的、预先注册的临界值容差之内，在另一个群体上则未达到该临界值，而在第一个群体上的假阳性约为两倍。 结论是不确定的，而能够延续下去的结果是错误的形态。 集中度能找到复杂度所在之处。 其中一些地方是上帝单元，另一些是正在完成其被编写使命的小类，而复杂度度量无法区分这两者，因为区别并不在复杂度之中。 两位阅读源代码的人也无法凭肉眼区分它们，并且只在一个问题上彼此一致：该类是否在处理其他对象的数据。 那是一个耦合问题，它值得下一项研究去度量它；那项研究所改进的检测器，才是应当带到智能体编写代码上的那个。

paragraphs.en: The author created and maintains OfficeFloor, a framework whose design rests on taking data off the control flow, and the construct the follow-on study tests, coupling divergence, comes from that line of work. This study compares no frameworks and its sample excludes the author’s own ecosystem, but the reading in Section 7 , that the false positives call for a coupling measure, is the reading the author’s interest favours, and a reader should weigh it as such. The author was one of the two readers of the false-positive sample; that reading was blind to PMD’s verdict, made under a protocol committed before it, and is reported beside the model’s with their disagreement. The sampler and the companion study are the author’s as well. Against the interest: the plan, the seed and the decision rule were fixed before the data existed, the verdict that resulted is inconclusive rather than favourable, every deviation is reported with its effect, and a replication needs no cooperation from the author.
paragraphs.zh: 作者创建并维护 OfficeFloor——一个设计基于“将数据从控制流中剥离”的框架，而后续研究中所检验的构造——耦合分歧（coupling divergence）——正是源自这一系列工作。 本研究不比较任何框架，其样本也不包含作者自己的生态系统，但第 7 节中的解读——即这些假阳性结果说明需要一种耦合度量——恰恰是作者的利益所倾向的解读，读者应当以此为前提加以权衡。 假阳性样本的两位阅读者之一就是作者本人；该阅读对 PMD 的判定结果保持盲态，依据事先提交的规程进行，其结果与模型的判定并列报告，并附上二者的分歧。 抽样器及配套研究同样出自作者之手。 不利于该利益的因素：实验计划、随机种子和决策规则在数据产生之前就已固定，最终得出的判定是不确定的而非有利的，所有偏差及其影响均已报告，且复现本研究无需作者配合。
